questions.question: Sanity check: this is a normal multiple-choice question, no code editor. What is $2^{5}$?
Write a function `reverse_string(s)` that returns the input string reversed.
Write a function `sum_evens(nums)` that returns the sum of only the even numbers in the list `nums`.

Write a class `Counter` with an `__init__` that takes a starting value, an `increment()` method, and a `value` attribute reflecting the current count. No test cases here — this one is graded purely on shape.
Write a function `is_palindrome(s)` that returns `True` if `s` reads the same forwards and backwards, `False` otherwise (case-sensitive, no need to strip spaces/punctuation).
